use_case: Customer-service chatbot with account access (web and app chat): answers billing, outage, and plan questions and takes limited account actions through the BSS API
vendor_or_model: Chatbot vendor (SaaS on a large language model platform)
build_or_buy: Buy (configured with company knowledge articles and a BSS API connector)
data_categories: Customer messages; account data including CPNI (call detail, voice plan, bills); chat transcripts
consequential_decision_category: None (payment arrangement offers come from fixed BSS rules; credits, deposits, and disconnections stay with agents); re-tier if authentication changes or credit decisions are added
human_in_the_loop: Agents handle credits, adjustments, disputes, and authentication changes; customers can reach a person at any time; account changes need customer confirmation
applicable_laws: 47 CFR 64.2007 and 64.2010(c), (e) (C-COMMUNICATIONS-R01); 64.2011 for any unauthorized disclosure; FTC Act Section 5 for broadband claims; Fla. Stat. 501.171 if Florida-defined personal information is exposed
status: In production since 2026-03-02; approved with conditions (COO 2026-09-17); "verify me" fallback disabled 2026-07-24

use_case: Contact center agent assist: real-time transcription of care calls, call summaries, and suggested answers in the CCaaS agent desktop
vendor_or_model: CCaaS vendor feature using a carved-out speech-to-text and language model subprocessor
data_categories: Call audio and transcripts with CPNI and personal information; agent notes
human_in_the_loop: Agents choose whether to use a suggestion; summaries are edited by the agent before saving
applicable_laws: 47 CFR 64.2010 (call detail still requires the password); Fla. Stat. 934.03(2)(d) (all-party consent to record); FTC Act Section 5
status: In production for 60 agents since 2026-05-11; expansion paused until conditions are met

use_case: NOC alarm correlation and predictive maintenance: groups network alarms into incidents, ranks them, and predicts cabinet battery and optics failures
vendor_or_model: OSS vendor add-on (machine learning models trained on company alarm history)
data_categories: Network alarms, element telemetry, circuit tags including 911 circuit tags; no customer personal data
affects_individuals: Yes (indirectly: service and 911 availability for customers and PSAPs)
consequential_decision_category: Safety/CI (influences outage detection and PSAP notification timing on a covered 911 network)
human_in_the_loop: NOC staff see raw alarms for every 911-tagged circuit; the tool opens and ranks tickets but cannot change network configurations
applicable_laws: 47 CFR 4.9(h) (30-minute PSAP notice depends on timely detection); 47 CFR 9.19(b) (reasonable measures for reliable 911, including network monitoring)
status: In production since 2025-10; approved with conditions (CTO and COO 2026-09-17)

use_case: Churn prediction and next-best-offer model: scores accounts for churn risk and recommends retention offers to care agents, the chatbot, and campaigns
vendor_or_model: In-house gradient-boosted model built by the data analytics team on the cloud data warehouse
data_categories: Account tenure, products, billing history, trouble tickets, and CDR-derived calling features (CPNI)
consequential_decision_category: None (marketing offers; no credit, deposit, or service eligibility decisions)
human_in_the_loop: Offers are suggestions; agents and campaign approvers decide; customers choose whether to accept
applicable_laws: 47 CFR 64.2005(b)(2) (no use of CPNI to track calls to competitors); 64.2007(b) and 64.2009(a), (c), (d) (approval checks, campaign records, supervisory review); FTC Act Section 5 for offer representations
status: In production since 2025-11; competitor-call feature removed 2026-08-28; approval filter due 2026-11-30

use_case: Enterprise generative AI assistant for staff (drafting, summarizing, and coding help) replacing unapproved public tools
vendor_or_model: Enterprise generative AI service with data protection terms (no training on company data)
data_categories: Internal documents; prohibited: CPNI, call detail, network configurations, lawful-intercept information
human_in_the_loop: Users review all outputs; no access to customer systems
applicable_laws: 47 CFR 64.2010(a) and 1.20003 (prohibited data must not be entered); POL-05 4.10
status: Pilot approved with conditions (Security Manager 2026-09-17); public tools blocked from 2026-12-31
